ei.title: Chapter 0-QN29 1번: Infants' Innate Drive to Imitate
ei.subject: 올림포스9대변별유형

fullPassage: A number of studies provide substantial evidence of an innate human disposition to respond differentially to social stimuli. From birth, infants will orient preferentially towards the human face and voice, seeming to know that such stimuli are particularly meaningful for them. Moreover, they register this connection actively, imitating a variety of facial gestures that are presented to them — tongue protrusions, lip tightenings, mouth openings. They will even try to match gestures with which they have some difficulty, experimenting with their own faces until they succeed. When they do succeed, they show pleasure by a brightening of their eyes; when they fail, they show distress. In other words, they not only have an innate capacity for matching their own kinaesthetically experienced bodily movements with those of others that are visually perceived; they have an innate drive to do so. That is, they seem to have an innate drive to imitate others whom they judge to be 'like me'.

③ brightening — 전치사 by 뒤 명사(동명사) 자리, by a brightening of their eyes 정상
④ judge — others whom they judge to be 'like me', 관계절 안 현재시제 동사 정상

questions.passage: A number of studies provide substantial evidence of an innate human disposition to ①<u>responds</u> differentially to social stimuli. From birth, infants will ②<u>orient</u> preferentially towards the human face and voice, seeming to know that such stimuli are particularly meaningful for them. Moreover, they ③<u>register</u> this connection actively, imitating a variety of facial gestures that are presented to them — tongue protrusions, lip tightenings, mouth openings. They will even try to match gestures with which they have some difficulty, experimenting with their own faces until they succeed. When they do succeed, they show pleasure by a brightening of their eyes; when they fail, they show distress. In other words, they not only have an innate capacity for matching their own kinaesthetically experienced bodily movements with those of others that are visually perceived; they have an innate drive to do so. That is, they seem to have an innate drive to ④<u>imitate</u> others whom they judge to be 'like me'.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

① respond — 원문 respond. an innate human disposition to respond differentially에서 to부정사이므로 동사원형 respond 필수. responds는 비문 ←정답
② orient — infants will orient, 조동사 will 뒤 동사원형 정상
③ register — they register this connection, 복수 주어 정상
④ imitate — drive to imitate others, to부정사 정상
